front: Khái niệm ''Must' vs. 'Have to'' trong Unit 5: Our Customs and Traditions được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
'Must' expresses internal obligation from the speaker's own feelings or moral sense; 'Have to' expresses external obligation from rules, laws, or circumstances.

💡 Ví dụ: I must call my grandmother today. (My personal wish) / You have to wear a uniform at school. (School rule)
🌱 Bản chất: In the past tense, 'had to' must be used because 'must' has no past form.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: ''Mustn't' (Prohibition) vs. 'Don't have to' (Lack of necessity)'?
back:
'Mustn't' means you are NOT allowed to do it (forbidden); 'Don't have to' means it is NOT necessary (you can do it if you want).

📝 Ví dụ: You mustn't speak loudly in the library. / Tomorrow is Sunday, so I don't have to wake up early.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Crucial distinction between prohibition and freedom of choice.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Choose 'mustn't' or 'don't have to': 'You __________ touch the temple statues; it is strictly forbidden.''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: 'strictly forbidden' signals a strict legal/religious prohibition.
Step 2: 'Mustn't' is the modal verb of strict prohibition.
Step 3: Complete sentence: 'You mustn't touch the temple statues; it is strictly forbidden.'

👉 Kết luận: mustn't

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Using 'mustn't' when you want to say something is unnecessary.?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Using 'mustn't' when you want to say something is unnecessary.

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: If something is not needed, use 'don't have to' or 'needn't'. 'Mustn't' means DO NOT DO IT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES.
